Posterior draws

Source: R/kb_samples.R, R/posterior_draws.R
kb_samples.Rd

The posterior draws of the estimated parameters from a fitted model.

Usage

kb_samples(fit, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
as_draws(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
nchains(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
niterations(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
ndraws(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
nvariables(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
variables(x, ...)

Arguments

fit

A kb_fit object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

x

A kb_fit object.

Value

A posterior draws_rvars object.

Details

The posterior functions, such as as_draws_df(), summarise_draws(), nchains(), ndraws(), and variables(), also accept a fit. summarise_draws(fit) reports each parameter's Rhat and effective sample size.

See also

Other fit methods: augment.kb_fit(), coef.kb_fit(), fitted.kb_fit(), glance.kb_fit(), kb_model_describe(), kb_stancode(), log_lik.kb_fit(), posterior_epred.kb_fit(), posterior_linpred.kb_fit(), posterior_predict.kb_fit(), prior_summary.kb_fit(), residuals.kb_fit(), summary.kb_fit(), tidy.kb_fit()

kb_samples(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
